info.description:
Library Management & E-Library System — REST API for authentication, the book catalog, borrowing, reading progress, and member management.
All endpoints except /health and /auth/* return the shared JSON envelope: {"success", "message"|"error", "data"|"code"}.
info.title: Bibliotheca API

post.description: Verifies credentials and returns access + refresh tokens
Revokes the given refresh token (does not touch the still-live access token — it just expires naturally)
Rotates the refresh token (one-time use — the old one is revoked) and returns a new access + refresh token pair

401.description: invalid, expired, or already-used refresh token

post.description: Creates a member account (role is always "member") and returns access + refresh tokens
author_ids is required (every author must already exist); author_roles is optional and positional. available_copies is set equal to total_copies and cannot be set directly.

400.description: invalid body, or an author_id doesn't exist

put.description: Use the assign/remove-author endpoints for authors, not this one. Changing total_copies adjusts available_copies by the same delta.

post.summary: Assign an author to a book

delete.description: Refuses if it would leave the book with zero authors
delete.summary: Remove an author from a book

400.description: invalid ids, or would leave zero authors

get.description: Streams the file (supports range requests). 404 if the book has no uploaded file yet.

404.description: book not found, or no file uploaded

post.description: multipart/form-data with a single field named "file". Only .pdf/.epub are accepted, up to MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE_MB. Sets is_digital=true on success; re-uploading replaces the previous file.

400.description: invalid id, unsupported format, too large, or missing file

get.description: Sweeps overdue records first, so status is always current as of this request.

post.description: 409 if you already have an active borrow for this book. 400 if no copies are available. due_at is now + BORROW_LOAN_DAYS.

400.description: invalid body, or no available copies

409.description: already have an active borrow for this book

patch.description: A member may only return their own borrow; librarian/admin may return anyone's (e.g. processing a physical return at a desk).

403.description: not your borrow, and not librarian/admin

get.description: Bookmarks are private per user — this never returns another user's bookmarks for the same book.
get.summary: List my bookmarks for a book

delete.description: 403 if the bookmark belongs to someone else or a different book — no admin override, a bookmark is a personal note.

patch.description: The plain, always-online counterpart to sync — no client_updated_at; the server stamps "now", which always beats an offline client syncing in later with an older timestamp.

get.summary: Get my reading session for a book

404.description: book not found, or no session started yet

patch.description: For offline clients: send local progress plus when it was last updated there. If the server already has a newer client_updated_at, this update is silently discarded and the response reflects the server's existing (newer) state — last write wins.

get.description: q matches book title/description (full-text) OR author name. genre/format/author/year are exact-match filters, independent of q and each other.

parameters.description: Free text — matches title/description or author name
parameters.name: q

parameters.description: Author ID (not a name — use q for name search)
parameters.name: author

get.description: Includes deactivated accounts (unlike most other lookups), so an admin can find and reactivate one.

patch.description: Only touches profile fields (phone_number, bio, profile_picture) — no route changes first_name/last_name/email yet.

get.description: Reading activity (from session data) — not the same as GET /borrows/my, which is checkout history.

patch.description: Upsert — calling it again for the same book updates the existing entry rather than creating a duplicate.
patch.summary: Set a book's status on my library shelf

patch.description: Deactivating immediately blocks the user's next login and any endpoint that filters to is_active=TRUE (e.g. their own GET /users/me starts 404ing, even with a still-valid token).

current_page.description:
CurrentPage has no "required" tag deliberately — 0 is the valid
starting value (page 0 / not started yet), and go-playground/validator's
"required" rejects the zero value for numeric types.

BearerAuth.description: Type "Bearer" followed by a space and the JWT access token (obtained from /auth/login or /auth/register).
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
